name: hue-md
description: Write Hue Markdown (.hue.md): colored spans, diff spans, keycaps, progress bars, multi-state tasks, and callout boxes (single or side-by-side) that stay readable as raw text. Preview in a pane or terminal slides and convert to GitHub Markdown.

auto_downgrade.title: Write a GitHub copy after each edit
auto_downgrade.description: After Claude writes or edits a .hue.md file, also write the GitHub Markdown version next to it (notes.hue.md -> notes.md). Never overwrites a .md file that hue-md did not generate.
